newsitem.title: FRANCE: ABN AMRO BUYS PHENIX BANK FROM AGF.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO BUYS PHENIX BANK FROM AGF.

text.p: French insurer Assurances Generales de France (AGF) said it reached a definite agreement to sell its Banque du Phenix unit to ABN AMRO .
AGF said the deal, which is subject to regulatory approval, would be effective by June 30, 1997 at the latest.
The price will be established on the basis of the 1996 accounts and goodwill paid by the buyer, AGF said, without giving any further financial details.

AGF said the sale would have no impact on the expected 1996 earnings per share of AGF. It said the sale fits with its strategy of reducing its exposure to banking risks, announced when the company was privatised.
